Hello,

I won't be able to help you (because I'm not one of the "masters" of INLA, not that I wouldn't like to help...) but It might be wise to provide the list with some info on your R environment (via sessionInfo() ), whether you are using inla.upgrade(testing=TRUE), etc.

HTH

Alex
